title: First agreements with the tall whites: speak English, sing to announce himself

tellings.quote: agreement I made with them was after realizing they were real that I asked him that whenever they came around me that they talk between themselves.

plain: In the desert near Indian Springs, Nevada, in the mid-1960s, a young Air Force man says he made agreements with tall, pale beings he calls the tall whites: that when they came near him they would talk between themselves where he could hear, in English, and that he would sing to let them know he was coming. Charles Hall, who says he served there as a weather observer, tells it as his own experience. He tells it as the start of a working relationship with beings who, if he is right, lived beside a US military base.
